jp: \t\t高らかな音を鳴らす角笛。基本的に単音しか出せないが、その雄々しい音色は人々の心を十分に揺さぶるだろう。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t高らかな音を鳴らす角笛。基本的に単音しか出せないが、その雄々しい音色は人々の心を十分に揺さぶるだろう。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A horn with a high-pitched sound. Basically, it can only produce a single note, but its heroic tone is sure to move people's hearts enough. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A horn with a high-pitched sound. Basically, it can only produce a single note, but its heroic tone is sure to move people's hearts enough. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Un corno che manda un suono squillante. In sostanza sa fare una nota sola, ma quel timbro fiero basterà a scuotere il cuore della gente. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t実際の武器と見紛う程の調度品。大地に刺さった剣をイメージして造られたものだが、過去これを強引に武器として扱った勇士がいたとかいないとか。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t実際の武器と見紛う程の調度品。大地に刺さった剣をイメージして造られたものだが、過去これを強引に武器として扱った勇士がいたとかいないとか。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n"
en: The furnishings are so large that they could easily be mistaken for actual weapons. It was made in the image of a sword stuck in the earth, but some brave warrior may or may not have used it as a weapon in the past. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~
en_grezzo: "The furnishings are so large that they could easily be mistaken for actual weapons. It was made in the image of a sword stuck in the earth, but some brave warrior may or may not have used it as a weapon in the past. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~"
it: Una suppellettile che si potrebbe scambiare per un'arma vera. È fatta a immagine di una spada piantata nella terra, e si dice, ma chi lo sa, che in passato un prode l'abbia usata a forza come arma. \n# ~Grande Compendio dei Giochi: Per Tutte le Età~

jp: \t\t精巧に作られた戦士を模した可動型人形。値は張るものの、様々な動きに対応できる為、子供達の憧れの的だという。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t精巧に作られた戦士を模した可動型人形。値は張るものの、様々な動きに対応できる為、子供達の憧れの的だという。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n"
en: These are movable dolls that resemble elaborately crafted warriors. Although expensive, they are said to be the object of children's admiration because of their ability to respond to a variety of movements. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~
en_grezzo: "These are movable dolls that resemble elaborately crafted warriors. Although expensive, they are said to be the object of children's admiration because of their ability to respond to a variety of movements. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~"
it: Un pupazzo snodabile fatto a immagine di un guerriero, lavorato con cura minuta. Costa caro, ma sa mettersi in ogni posa, e per questo, dicono, i bambini lo sognano. \n# ~Grande Compendio dei Giochi: Per Tutte le Età~

jp: \t\t「フハハハハ！スゴいぞー！カッコイイぞー！」\n#～街の子供のセスの言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「フハハハハ！スゴいぞー！カッコイイぞー！」\n#～街の子供のセスの言葉～\n"
en: \"Muhahahaha! Great! Cool!\" \n# ~words of <Seth> the kid~
en_grezzo: "\"Muhahahaha! Great! Cool!\" \n# ~words of <Seth> the kid~"
it: \"Uahahaha! Che forte! Che figo!\" \n# ~Parole di <Seth>, ragazzino di città~

jp: \t\t同じ種類の皿が重ねられた家具。急なお客が来る時に便利だが、慌てて躓いて割ってしまった、なんてことにならないように床に置くのは止めた方がいいだろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t同じ種類の皿が重ねられた家具。急なお客が来る時に便利だが、慌てて躓いて割ってしまった、なんてことにならないように床に置くのは止めた方がいいだろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: Furniture with plates of the same kind stacked on top of each other. They are useful when you have a sudden guest, but you probably shouldn't put them on the floor lest you trip over them in your haste and break them. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "Furniture with plates of the same kind stacked on top of each other. They are useful when you have a sudden guest, but you probably shouldn't put them on the floor lest you trip over them in your haste and break them. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un mobile con impilati piatti tutti dello stesso tipo. Comodo quando arrivano ospiti all'improvviso, ma meglio non posarlo per terra: basta inciampare nella fretta e va tutto in pezzi. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t縦に重ねられた効率的な寝具。宿屋に備え付けられていることが多く、冒険者達が泊った際に、しばしばどちらが上で寝るか喧嘩をしている光景を目にするという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t縦に重ねられた効率的な寝具。宿屋に備え付けられていることが多く、冒険者達が泊った際に、しばしばどちらが上で寝るか喧嘩をしている光景を目にするという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Efficient bedding stacked vertically. They are often provided in inns, and when adventurers stay there, they often see fights over who gets to sleep on top. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Efficient bedding stacked vertically. They are often provided in inns, and when adventurers stay there, they often see fights over who gets to sleep on top. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio efficiente, con un letto impilato sopra l'altro. Si trova spesso nelle locande, e dicono che quando ci dormono gli avventurieri capiti di vederli litigare su chi va di sopra. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tそこに歴史を感じる墓。当然ながら非常に重いので持ち上げてみようと思わない方がいいだろう。\n#～死にゆく者へ贈る書～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tそこに歴史を感じる墓。当然ながら非常に重いので持ち上げてみようと思わない方がいいだろう。\n#～死にゆく者へ贈る書～\n"
en: A tomb with a sense of history in it. Naturally it is very heavy and you should not try to lift it. \n# ~Book for the Dying Ones~
en_grezzo: "A tomb with a sense of history in it. Naturally it is very heavy and you should not try to lift it. \n# ~Book for the Dying Ones~"
it: Una tomba da cui si sente il passare della storia. Naturalmente il peso è enorme, e non conviene nemmeno pensare di provare a sollevare una cosa simile. \n# ~Libro in Dono a Chi Sta Morendo~

jp: \t\t古の権力者の為に作られた巨大な墓。当然ながら非常に重いので持ち上げてみようと思わない方がいいだろう。\n#～死にゆく者へ贈る書～\n

en_grezzo: "A beautiful tomb covered in flowers. Naturally, it is very heavy and you should not try to lift it. \n# ~Book for the Dying Ones~"

jp_grezzo: "\t\t人の手から離れて大分経つ墓。当然ながら非常に重いので持ち上げてみようと思わない方がいいだろう。\n#～死にゆく者へ贈る書～\n"

en_grezzo: "The tomb has long since left human hands. Naturally, it is very heavy and you should not try to lift it. \n# ~Book for the Dying Ones~"
it: Una tomba che da parecchio nessuno cura più. Naturalmente il peso è enorme, e non conviene nemmeno pensare di provare a sollevare una cosa simile. \n# ~Libro in Dono a Chi Sta Morendo~

jp: \t\t絹で織られた反物。売約済みと大きく書かれているので使用することはできない。\n#～パルミア春夏物コレクション～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t絹で織られた反物。売約済みと大きく書かれているので使用することはできない。\n#～パルミア春夏物コレクション～\n"
en: Woven silk antique. It is marked 'sold' in large letters and cannot be used. \n# ~Palmian Summer Fashion~
en_grezzo: "Woven silk antique. It is marked 'sold' in large letters and cannot be used. \n# ~Palmian Summer Fashion~"
it: Una pezza tessuta in seta. C'è scritto a lettere grandi che è già venduta, e perciò non si può usare. \n# ~Palmia: Collezione Primavera-Estate~

jp: \t\t地上に散らばった衣服。洗濯前の脱ぎ散らかしなのか、洗濯後の整頓前なのか、どちらであるかは定かではない。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t地上に散らばった衣服。洗濯前の脱ぎ散らかしなのか、洗濯後の整頓前なのか、どちらであるかは定かではない。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n"
en: Clothes scattered on the ground. It is not certain whether they were taken off and scattered before washing or before tidying up after washing. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~
en_grezzo: "Clothes scattered on the ground. It is not certain whether they were taken off and scattered before washing or before tidying up after washing. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~"
it: Vestiti sparsi per terra. Se siano stati buttati lì prima del bucato, o se il bucato sia fatto e manchi solo di piegarli, non è chiaro. \n#~Le Mille Cianfrusaglie che Amo~

jp: \t\tどこからどう見ても棚そのものだ。それ以上でもそれ以下でもない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tどこからどう見ても棚そのものだ。それ以上でもそれ以下でもない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: For all intents and purposes, it is the shelf itself. Nothing more, nothing less. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "For all intents and purposes, it is the shelf itself. Nothing more, nothing less. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Da qualunque parte lo si guardi, è uno scaffale e basta. Niente di più e niente di meno. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t装飾品という面に重きを置いた燭台。台座にもふんだんに贅沢な加工がなされており、キャンドルが不要な程光り輝いている。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t装飾品という面に重きを置いた燭台。台座にもふんだんに贅沢な加工がなされており、キャンドルが不要な程光り輝いている。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: This is a candelabra with an emphasis on the decorative aspect. The base is also lavishly processed, it shines so brightly that candles are unnecessary. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "This is a candelabra with an emphasis on the decorative aspect. The base is also lavishly processed, it shines so brightly that candles are unnecessary. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un candelabro pensato soprattutto come ornamento. Anche il piede è lavorato con un lusso senza risparmio, e risplende al punto che la candela non serve. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\tご婦人方の憧れである雰囲気あるテーブル。ただのテーブルなのに気品に満ちあふれている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tご婦人方の憧れである雰囲気あるテーブル。ただのテーブルなのに気品に満ちあふれている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: An atmospheric table that is every lady's dream. It is just a table, but it is full of elegance. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "An atmospheric table that is every lady's dream. It is just a table, but it is full of elegance. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo pieno di atmosfera, il sogno delle signore. È un tavolo e nient'altro, eppure trabocca di nobiltà. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t主婦達の期待に答え小型化を実現した食卓。フルコースを食べるのでない限り、この位の大きさで十分なのだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t主婦達の期待に答え小型化を実現した食卓。フルコースを食べるのでない限り、この位の大きさで十分なのだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: This dining table has been miniaturized to meet the expectations of housewives. Unless you are eating a full course meal, this size is probably sufficient. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "This dining table has been miniaturized to meet the expectations of housewives. Unless you are eating a full course meal, this size is probably sufficient. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo da pranzo rimpicciolito, come le padrone di casa chiedevano. A meno di non mangiare un pranzo a tutte portate, una misura così basterà. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tコンロが備え付けられた調理台。一台で２つの事ができる為、朝が忙しい御婦人方に専らの人気だ。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tコンロが備え付けられた調理台。一台で２つの事ができる為、朝が忙しい御婦人方に専らの人気だ。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: Cooking table equipped with a stove. Because two tasks can be done with a single stove, it is popular among ladies who are busy in the mornings. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "Cooking table equipped with a stove. Because two tasks can be done with a single stove, it is popular among ladies who are busy in the mornings. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un bancone da cucina con i fornelli sopra. Un mobile solo fa due cose, e per questo va per la maggiore fra le signore che al mattino hanno fretta. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t食材の下拵えに適した流し台。我慢しきれずこの場で料理を作ってしまうせっかちな人もいるのだとか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食材の下拵えに適した流し台。我慢しきれずこの場で料理を作ってしまうせっかちな人もいるのだとか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A sink suitable for food preparation. Some impatient people can't resist and cook their food right here. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A sink suitable for food preparation. Some impatient people can't resist and cook their food right here. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un lavello adatto a preparare gli ingredienti. C'è chi, impaziente, non resiste e finisce per cucinare lì sopra. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t食材の下拵えに適した調理台。我慢しきれずこの場で料理を作ってしまうせっかちな人もいるのだとか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食材の下拵えに適した調理台。我慢しきれずこの場で料理を作ってしまうせっかちな人もいるのだとか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A table suitable for food preparation. Some impatient people can't resist and cook their food right here. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~

it: Un bancone adatto a preparare gli ingredienti. C'è chi, impaziente, non resiste e finisce per cucinare lì sopra. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t両手に余るほどの沢山の酒。飲みきれないので使用することはできない。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t両手に余るほどの沢山の酒。飲みきれないので使用することはできない。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: So much booze that it is too much for both hands. Cannot be used because it is undrinkable. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "So much booze that it is too much for both hands. Cannot be used because it is undrinkable. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: Tanto liquore che non sta in due mani. Non lo si finirebbe mai, e perciò non si può usare. \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\tその道のプロが精魂込めて作り上げた本棚。一見シンプルに見えるが、普段見えない部分に匠の遊び心が隠れている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tその道のプロが精魂込めて作り上げた本棚。一見シンプルに見えるが、普段見えない部分に匠の遊び心が隠れている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A bookshelf created by professionals who put their heart and soul into their work. At first glance, it looks simple, but the playful spirit of a master craftsman is hidden in parts that are not usually seen. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A bookshelf created by professionals who put their heart and soul into their work. At first glance, it looks simple, but the playful spirit of a master craftsman is hidden in parts that are not usually seen. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una libreria costruita con tutta l'anima da chi è maestro del mestiere. A prima vista sembra semplice, ma nelle parti che di solito non si vedono si nasconde l'estro dell'artigiano. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tその道のプロが精魂込めて作り上げた箪笥。一見シンプルに見えるが、普段見えない裏側に匠の遊び心が隠れている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tその道のプロが精魂込めて作り上げた箪笥。一見シンプルに見えるが、普段見えない裏側に匠の遊び心が隠れている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Cabinet made by craftsmen who put their hearts and souls into their work. At first glance, they may look simple, but the playful spirit of the artisan is hidden behind the scenes, hidden from view. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Cabinet made by craftsmen who put their hearts and souls into their work. At first glance, they may look simple, but the playful spirit of the artisan is hidden behind the scenes, hidden from view. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una cassettiera costruita con tutta l'anima da chi è maestro del mestiere. A prima vista sembra semplice, ma sul retro, che di solito non si vede, si nasconde l'estro dell'artigiano. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t読了後、床に丁寧に重ねられた本。殆どが専門的な本なので、特に読むべき情報はないだろう。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読了後、床に丁寧に重ねられた本。殆どが専門的な本なので、特に読むべき情報はないだろう。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: These books were carefully stacked on the floor after reading. Most of the books are technical, so there will be nothing special to read. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "These books were carefully stacked on the floor after reading. Most of the books are technical, so there will be nothing special to read. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Libri impilati con cura sul pavimento dopo la lettura. Sono quasi tutti libri da specialisti, e non ci sarà granché da leggere. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t読了後、片づけられなかった本。殆どが大衆雑誌なので、特に読むべき情報はないだろう。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読了後、片づけられなかった本。殆どが大衆雑誌なので、特に読むべき情報はないだろう。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Books that one could not put away after reading. Mostly magazines, so there would be no special information to read. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Books that one could not put away after reading. Mostly magazines, so there would be no special information to read. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Libri che dopo la lettura nessuno ha rimesso a posto. Sono quasi tutti rotocalchi, e non ci sarà granché da leggere. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t厳めしい雰囲気を身に纏う全身鎧。いかにも曰くありげな装備品のように見えるが実際の所レプリカなので装備することはできない。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t厳めしい雰囲気を身に纏う全身鎧。いかにも曰くありげな装備品のように見えるが実際の所レプリカなので装備することはできない。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Full-body armor with a stern atmosphere. Although it looks like special equipment, it is in fact a replica and cannot be worn. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Full-body armor with a stern atmosphere. Although it looks like special equipment, it is in fact a replica and cannot be worn. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un'armatura completa che si porta addosso un'aria severa. Sembra proprio un pezzo con una storia dietro, ma in realtà è una copia e non si può indossare. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t陳列用に配置された鎧。大きく試着不可と書かれている為、装備することはできない。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t陳列用に配置された鎧。大きく試着不可と書かれている為、装備することはできない。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n"
en: Armor placed for display. It is marked 'not for try-on' so you cannot equip it. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~
en_grezzo: "Armor placed for display. It is marked 'not for try-on' so you cannot equip it. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~"
it: Un'armatura messa lì per esposizione. C'è scritto a lettere grandi che non si può provare, e perciò non si può indossare. \n# ~Vita da Mercante Dopo l'Avventura~

jp: \t\t陳列用に配置された服。大きく試着不可と書かれている為、装備することはできない。\n#～パルミア春夏物コレクション～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t陳列用に配置された服。大きく試着不可と書かれている為、装備することはできない。\n#～パルミア春夏物コレクション～\n"
en: Clothes placed for display. It is marked 'not for try-on' so you cannot equip it. \n# ~Palmian Summer Fashion~
en_grezzo: "Clothes placed for display. It is marked 'not for try-on' so you cannot equip it. \n# ~Palmian Summer Fashion~"
it: Un abito messo lì per esposizione. C'è scritto a lettere grandi che non si può provare, e perciò non si può indossare. \n# ~Palmia: Collezione Primavera-Estate~

jp: \t\t展示用に束ねられた武具。あくまでもまとめ売り用らしく、個別に売ることはしていないようだ。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t展示用に束ねられた武具。あくまでもまとめ売り用らしく、個別に売ることはしていないようだ。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n"
en: Stack of weapons bundled for display. They seem to be for sale in bulk and not sold individually. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~
en_grezzo: "Stack of weapons bundled for display. They seem to be for sale in bulk and not sold individually. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~"
it: Armi e armature legate in fascio per l'esposizione. Pare si vendano solo in blocco, e mai a pezzo singolo. \n# ~Vita da Mercante Dopo l'Avventura~

jp: \t\t大小様々な重ねられた弓。あくまでもまとめ売り用らしく、個別に売ることはしていないようだ。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大小様々な重ねられた弓。あくまでもまとめ売り用らしく、個別に売ることはしていないようだ。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n"
en: Stacked bows of various sizes. They seem to be for bulk sale only and are not sold individually. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~
en_grezzo: "Stacked bows of various sizes. They seem to be for bulk sale only and are not sold individually. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~"
it: Archi di ogni misura, impilati uno sull'altro. Pare si vendano solo in blocco, e mai a pezzo singolo. \n# ~Vita da Mercante Dopo l'Avventura~

jp: \t\t焼く、蒸す、煮る、全てを万能にこなす、優れた調理器具。非常に大きく重量もあるので購入に尻込みしてしまうが、その分実力は折り紙つきである。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t焼く、蒸す、煮る、全てを万能にこなす、優れた調理器具。非常に大きく重量もあるので購入に尻込みしてしまうが、その分実力は折り紙つきである。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: This is an excellent all-around cookware for baking, steaming, and stewing. It is very large and heavy, which may make people hesitate to purchase it, but it is a proven performer. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "This is an excellent all-around cookware for baking, steaming, and stewing. It is very large and heavy, which may make people hesitate to purchase it, but it is a proven performer. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un ottimo arnese da cucina che fa tutto: arrostisce, cuoce a vapore, lessa. È grandissimo e pesa molto, tanto che a comprarlo si esita, ma in cambio la sua bravura è garantita. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t大陸全土が描かれた地図。冒険者達もそうでない者も、これを読むことでまだ見ぬ彼の地へ思いをはせるのだ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大陸全土が描かれた地図。冒険者達もそうでない者も、これを読むことでまだ見ぬ彼の地へ思いをはせるのだ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n"
en: A map of the entire continent. Adventurers and non-adventurers alike are encouraged to read this map and think of the lands yet to be discovered. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~
en_grezzo: "A map of the entire continent. Adventurers and non-adventurers alike are encouraged to read this map and think of the lands yet to be discovered. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~"
it: Una mappa che disegna il continente intero. Avventurieri e non, leggendola, lasciano andare il pensiero alle terre che non hanno ancora visto. \n# ~Da Oggi Avventuriero Anche Tu: Manuale di Viaggio~

jp: \t\t天頂に花があしらわれた立派な柱。これは古代の建築様式を復元したものであるという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t天頂に花があしらわれた立派な柱。これは古代の建築様式を復元したものであるという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Magnificent pillars with flowers decorated at the zenith. This is said to be a restoration of an ancient architectural style. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Magnificent pillars with flowers decorated at the zenith. This is said to be a restoration of an ancient architectural style. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una bella colonna con dei fiori guarniti in cima. È il ripristino, dicono, di un antico modo di costruire. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t天頂に植物があしらわれた立派な柱。これは古代の建築様式を復元したものであるという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t天頂に植物があしらわれた立派な柱。これは古代の建築様式を復元したものであるという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Magnificent pillars decorated with plants at the zenith. This is said to be a restoration of an ancient architectural style. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Magnificent pillars decorated with plants at the zenith. This is said to be a restoration of an ancient architectural style. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una bella colonna con delle piante guarnite in cima. È il ripristino, dicono, di un antico modo di costruire. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~
